AMP1._note: Block key is 'AMP1' to match the master-map key (what _resolve_topo_block returns for AMP/AMP1). Unlike the DRIVE block, the Axe-Edit AMP editor uses FIXED generic labels for the tone-stack knobs across ALL amp models (Gain/Bass/Mid/Treble/Presence/Depth/Master Volume/Level/Input Trim) â€” it does NOT relabel per model the way each Drive pedal does. VERIFIED on a 2nd, very different amp: switching Friedman HBE V3 -> Class-A 30W Hot (Vox-style) changed only WHICH knobs are shown (the Vox hides Bass/Mid/Treble/Presence/Depth and shows a 'High Cut' tone knob instead) â€” the knobs that remain keep their generic labels. So per-model differences are VISIBILITY, not RELABELING. The front-panel knobs are pure identity and live in common_labels; per-model relabels come only from PHYSICAL amps' printed knob names (a future documentation pass), not from Axe-Edit's screen. (The Vox 'High Cut' Tone-page knob -> generic param is unverified here; not one of the universal tone-stack knobs, so out of Phase-A scope.)

advanced_notes.coverage: AMP advanced pages (Axe-Edit tabs Ideal/Preamp/Power Amp/Pwr Tubes+CF/Power Supply/Speaker/Input EQ/Output EQ/Dynamics) walked live. Like the Tone page they use FIXED GENERIC labels across amp models, so the vast majority of advanced params are IDENTITY (Axe-Edit label == generic name -> already resolves, no entry needed). Only genuine mismatches + high-value shorthand aliases were added to common_labels.
advanced_notes.mismatches_added: Input EQ 'Low Cut' -> Low Cut Frequency (p6, live-verified); Output-EQ graphic-EQ faders '62'..'8K' -> 'EQ 62'..'EQ 8K' (p55-62; 1K live-verified + ordered).
advanced_notes.aliases_added: Feedback->Negative Feedback(24); sag->Supply Sag(19); transformer{drive/matching/lowfreq/hifreq/highfreq}->XFormer* (46/51/12/13); speakercompression->Speaker Compress.(115); low/highfreqresonance->LF/HF Reso(27/44); output comp{ression/threshold/clarity/type}->Out Comp*(75/76/70/109); tubetype->Preamp Tube Type(69, ambiguous default).
advanced_notes.preamp_sag_gap: RESOLVED (direct-probe): 'Preamp Sag' is AMP1 param_id 96, an ON/OFF TOGGLE SWITCH (Off=0/On=1, device floors the SET float to the index) â€” NOT a continuous knob, and DISTINCT from Supply Sag (p19, 0-10 knob). CORRECTION: the 'val 2.10' this note previously attributed to Preamp Sag is actually TUBE HARDNESS (p48), the knob immediately right of the Preamp Sag switch on the Preamp tab. pid 96 is now hand-added to axefx_sysex_map.json (AMP1), so a SET command(AMP1,'Preamp Sag',...) resolves directly; live-verified.
advanced_notes.duplicate_generic_names: Several AMP generic names collide across pages; a SET command resolves the FIRST match. Depth: p16 (tone-stack) vs p90 (Bias Tremolo). Gain: p1 (amp) vs p73 (Input EQ). Frequency: p72 (Input EQ) vs p89 (Bias Tremolo). Type: p92 (graphic EQ) vs p102 (Input EQ). Compression: p80 (Cathode Follower). For Depth/Gain the first match (p16/p1) is the desired common one; Frequency/Type are genuinely ambiguous by bare name -> use a fuller/tab-specific name. Not remapped here (the label index maps display-labels, not generic-name disambiguation).
advanced_notes.controls_not_in_98_map: On/off voicing switches + a few combos seen in Axe-Edit are not among the 98 mapped slider/combo params (out of scope, no entries): Ideal tab Boost/Cut/Fat/Bright switches; Power Amp 'NFB Compensation' switch; Speaker 'Speaker Imp. Curve' combo; Output EQ 'Off/On' enable + 'Zero All' button. Note 'Boost Type'(p123) and 'Boost Level'(p122) ARE mapped and identity.

ambiguous_not_common.volume: DELIBERATELY OMITTED from common_labels (same lesson as DRIVE's 'volume'): on amps 'Volume' is ambiguous â€” a non-master-volume amp's 'Volume' is the preamp gain (Gain p1), a master-volume amp's channel 'Volume' can be Master Volume (p5), and some amps print 'Volume' for the output. Map 'volume' PER-MODEL after live verification, never block-wide.
ambiguous_not_common.low_high: 'Low'/'High' NOT added block-wide: could alias Bass(p2)/Treble(p4) on amps with a Low/Mid/High EQ, but risk colliding with 'Low Cut'/'High Cut' and no amp on 0000 uses those labels to verify. Defer to a per-model pass.
ambiguous_not_common.bright: The 'Bright' control (Bright Cap p10) is a per-model SWITCH, not a universal front-panel knob â€” Friedman HBE V3 does not expose it on the Tone or Preamp page. Not a common label; add per-model where an amp shows it.

availability_schema.purpose: Per-model AMP tone-stack control AVAILABILITY: which standard front-panel controls Axe-Edit EXPOSES vs HIDES for each amp model. Distinct from labels â€” the AMP block uses fixed generic labels across all models (see AMP1._note); what varies per model is VISIBILITY. Operator directive.
availability_schema.method: Switch the amp model (set_block_model / model picker), CONFIRM the switch (TYPE field + top-bar 'Amp 1: (A) <model>' updated), then read the Axe-Edit Tone page via the session-1 screenshot harness and record which standard controls render. Exposed-vs-hidden is a per-MODEL trait Axe-Edit computes at model-load; a SysEx Tonestack Type change did NOT re-expose a hidden stack, so read visibility right after the model switch.
availability_schema.inert_vs_hidden: Hidden params are UI-HIDDEN, not protocol-absent: the param slot is block-global (same pid for every model) and a SysEx SET is ACCEPTED (status:set) for a hidden control, but it produces no visible change and is functionally INERT for that model's topology (a cut-only Vox has no Bass/Mid/Treble band). Verified live: on Class-A 30W Hot, set Bass p2=9 -> Tone page unchanged, no Bass knob appeared. A definitive audio inert-vs-live check would need signal analysis (not performed).
availability_schema.fields: Models.<id>.availability = {exposed:[...standard controls shown], hidden:[...standard controls not shown], extra_controls:[...non-standard controls shown, e.g. 'High Cut'], topology:<cluster label>, verified:<date/method>}

CONTROL._note: DEVICE-VERIFIED (daytime, spike; extends): SYSTEM block (official enum ID_CONTROL = 2), not a grid effect. The whole Controllers view is now indexed with page-scoped keys (LFO 1/2, ADSR 1/2, Envelope, Sequencer + 32 stages, Manual 1-5, Scene Ctrl 1-4, Pitch). Key discipline: the view's bare labels ('Rate', 'Type', 'Tempo', 'Attack', 'Input Source', 'Quantize',...) repeat across its pages AND across effect blocks, so bare labels stay UNindexed -- use the page-prefixed keys (lfo1rate, adsr2type, sequencerstage32, scenectrl1scene1, pitchinputsource,...) or the map names. *** DEVICE-PERSISTENT: CONTROL writes survive preset changes AND Axe-Edit close -- GLOBAL-style restore discipline (write the old value back; no reload-to-revert). *** Announce laws: combos = unsolicited 01 09 (idx/(N-1)); continuous sliders = 01 0C/0D (some 01 0A/0B), same field layout as 09. Modifier GET = sub 01 07 (top-level II func 0x07 NAKs 64 07 05). *** The Metronome level sliders on this view are NOT here -- they announce as GLOBAL (block 1) pids 119-121 (keys live on the GLOBAL block). Scene Ctrl 3/4 keys are stride-inferred (not individually probed). Func 0x14 is GET-only (stale STORED preset tempo); the real tempo writes: preset = pid 32, global = GLOBAL pid 0.

Announce laws: combos broadcast 01 09 (idx/(N-1)); continuous sliders announce via 01 0C/0D (and 01 0A/0B for e.g. Quantize/Stages) -- 60-B frames, same field layout as 09; 0C/0A on the step, 0D/0B on the inverse/commit. A slider walk that only listens for 09 sees nothing.
DEVICE-PERSISTENT law: CONTROL writes persist across preset changes and Axe-Edit close -- restore = write-back only (the notes's 'reload reverts' assumption is REFUTED).

investigation_notes.Note 2..7 / Key (scale-table): Session: under type 4 Dual Diatonic with Scale=Custom (pid 9=~20), scanned pid band 64-80 watching Note 2-7. No pid changes a single Note field: pid 65 transposes ALL notes uniformly (+5 semis), pid 64 blanks them.
